run_test_framework: run the CTestFramework to execute all test suites and generate a pass/fail report
run_test_suite: run a specific test suite with its cases using CTestFramework.run_suite
run_test_case: run a single test case through CTestFramework.run_case with setup, execution, and cleanup callbacks
load_test_suites: load all available test suites from the suites directory using CTestFramework.load_suites
report_test_result: report a test case pass or fail result using report_success or report_fail functions
